items.text: Saquon Barkley active for MNF vs Cowboys after expected-to-play designation.
items.why: Schefter and Rap confirm from Eagles inactives; ETR expected
items.implication: Lead RB role vs DAL; limits other Eagles RB upside

items.text: Puka Nacua officially active vs Raiders after GTD/optimism on calf.
items.why: Schefter confirmation; ETR had GTD optimism; Rap also noted active
items.implication: Full WR1 role expected; reverse any Davante/Adams or other beneficiary stashes

items.text: Breece Hall inactive; ETR had GTD/pessimism.
items.why: Schefter actives/inactives list; ETR pessimism pre-game
items.implication: Full lead role for backup RB vs Miami

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT in ETR weekend injury summary for Week 7.
items.implication: Ravens QB streamer needed; Flowers/Andrews/Likely volume shifts possible without Lamar
items.opportunity: Backup QB and pass-catchers in Baltimore offense

items.text: Jonah Coleman first game back led Broncos RB snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins 21% snaps; Harvey one fluky rec TD. LOVE/upgrade.
items.why: Berry snap/rush/route data; clear lead post-return

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but not certain; earlier expected as Giants lead back.
items.why: Levitan post-game assessment vs pre-game Rap lead-back note
items.implication: Monitor; possible Tracy or committee if limited
items.opportunity: If out, backup RB snaps; if in limited, reduced

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs almost certainly fine after ankle turn on purposeful slide; would have been tilting if actually injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Levitan direct take on ETR watch list slide

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT per ETR weekend summary.
items.implication: Eagles WR targets redistribute; Wicks also out compounds
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining Eagles pass-catchers

items.text: Dontayvion Wicks OUT alongside DeVonta Smith.
items.implication: Further thins Eagles WR room for MNF; Lemon/slot opportunity noted by Berry

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN per ETR; Berry discusses ROS value post-return.
items.why: ETR IN list; Berry video on ROS expectations
items.implication: Reclaims lead Packers RB role; monitor share vs committee

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value-touch thesis: worst runner efficiency (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) yet fantasy RB13 PPR via 9 inside-5 carries and league-leading 45 RB targets.
items.why: Levitan data on RZ/targets despite efficiency
items.implication: Sustainable floor via opportunity; hold/start through inefficiency

items.text: Tony Pollard exploded Sunday; sell-high opportunity if possible.
items.implication: Trade while value peaked; efficiency/role may regress

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24, Noel 15 (turf toe early exit), Hutchinson 15, Boutte 13, Marvin Harrison 8, Tank Dell 6 (return).
items.why: Levitan post-game route counts; Dell limited in return
items.implication: Nico clear alpha; Dell not immediate full share threat
items.opportunity: Nico route/target dominance; Dell ramp slow

items.text: Xavier Worthy ran 33 routes on 36 Mahomes dropbacks (2nd game sans Rice); has never topped 83 rec yards in 37 career games.
items.implication: High opportunity but historical ceiling cap; volatile WR3/flex
